أستصبح (form X)
# أَسْتَصْبِحُ (ʔastaṣbiḥu) /ʔas.tasˤ.bi.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
# أُسْتَصْبَحُ (ʔustaṣbaḥu) /ʔus.tasˤ.ba.ħu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
# أَسْتَصْبِحَ (ʔastaṣbiḥa) /ʔas.tasˤ.bi.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
# أُسْتَصْبَح
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
